text:
taylor: T-minus 6h to prod ramp for multi-slice rollout. Canary at 2% (slice-a). Latency 95p: 180ms, error rate 0.1%. Plan: watch for KV cache errors, then shift to 10% at +2h if stable. Tagging folks: @maya @raj @ash
maya: ack. I re-ran canary smoke; no obvious errors. Saw small spike in mem on node gpu-3 ~10m ago. Patch queued: https://git.internal/rwinf/pr/432
raj: I'm on alert for metrics; increasing log level for kv-cache to debug for next 30m. If noise, revert.
ash: quick question: what's the exact flag command to nudge slices? last time we used `redwoodctl rollout set --slice slice-a --pct 10`
taylor: yep that's it. example:
```
redwoodctl rollout set --flag multi_slice_rollout --slice slice-a --pct 10
```
ops_lead: ops FYI — I forwarded capacity increase request to infra. If CPU climbs >75% on b-gpu-pool we'll pause.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished 2024-11-12 14:03:05 UTC. image: rwinf/multi-slice:v3.4.1 diff: minor config tweak
maya: no SLO alerts in last 15m. rolling logs show repeated `kv_cache_miss` warnings ~15/sec but token throughput steady.
raj: thanks. I'll keep debug on for 45m. ping me if we go to 10% and error rate >0.5%
taylor: action items: (1) Maya watch mem/gpu-3 (2) Raj monitor KV cache + logs (3) Ash ready to run rollout command at +2h (4) Ops pause if infra alerts. Back here in 1h w/ status :thumbsup: 
ash: got it, I'll be ready. If anything, I'll flip to safe-model fallback via `--model fallback-small`.
maya: noted. quick heads-up — QA reported one rerank inconsistency for long prompts; not sure if related. filing ticket: https://tickets/RED-789
taylor: thanks. If rerank issue spikes after 10% we rollback slice to 0.5% and mark for postmortem.
raj: copying traces to #incidents if we see errors >0.5% :eyes: 
ops_lead: standing by. :shipit:
